title: Kaali Masoor Daal (Brown Whole Lentils)

source.text: S. Abbas Raza, Pakistani & North Indian Cooking (2015)

description: A hearty, meaty whole-lentil daal, with rice in summer and bread in winter. Too robust for delicate dishes; pair with a spicy meat or vegetable, or just plain rice and raw onion.

steps.action: Rinse a few times in a large pot with cold water; drain well:
items: 2 cups kaali masoor daal (whole brown lentils, 480 ml)

steps.action: Add and bring to a boil on high:
Add; reduce to medium (5/10) and simmer covered:
items: 6 medium garlic cloves, thinly sliced (about 2 mm / ¹⁄₁₆ in)
Half of: 4 cu in ginger (2 × 3 × 10 cm), peeled, in ⅛ in (3 mm) dice

steps.action: At 45 min, check that grains mash easily against the pot; if so, mash about an eighth to thicken. If not, cook 10 min more and repeat.
Bring to porridge consistency; if no liquid shows on top, add:
Cook about 10 min more, until soft; repeat if needed. Turn off heat.
Tarka: heat in a small frying pan over high, 2 min:
Add and fry; when the onion just starts to color, add the rest:
items: 1 medium onion (8 oz / 225 g), quartered and finely sliced

steps.action: When the onion is medium brown, pour slowly into the daal (it splatters), scraping the pan. Stir well. Adjust salt.
